module: Photo mode flash: creates a spotlight (SpotLight, with shadows, not saved in the level) attached to the camera during photo mode, aimed at the target point (raycast from the camera, otherwise the DOF focus distance). Two modes: "always" (continuously on) and "pulse" (on only during the capture). In pulse mode, runCapture waits 2 warm-up frames, triggers the capture via the screenshot module, then turns the flash off on receiving onScreenshotAllDone (or after 60 fallback frames). The photo mode UI calls applyFromUi.

enabled.desc: true if the flash is active (the spotlight exists)

outerAngle.desc: Outer cone angle in degrees (default 55, from 1 to 179)

saturation.desc: Saturation in percent, 0 to 100 (default 0: white light)

capturePulseActive.desc: true during a flash pulse tied to a capture

notes: The spotlight is offset from the camera: 0.12 m to the right, 0.06 m up and 0.05 m forward; range 40 m; shadow map 1024.
The flash only applies if photo mode is open (global variable photoModeOpen or ui_photomode_shared.S.photoModeOpen) and if the active camera is not "path".

Capture types accepted by runCapture (kind): takeScreenShot, takeBigScreenShot, takeHugeScreenShot, takeCustomScreenShot, takeMotionBlurScreenShot, publish, steam. They delegate to the screenshot module; "steam" does not go through the capture-end hook.
runCapture without an active flash simply starts the capture. In pulse mode, a second request during a pulse is refused (false, "capture_busy").
The hue, saturation and outerAngle values are rounded to integers; the intensity is only clamped.

enable.desc: Enables or disables the flash: on activation creates the SpotLight in MissionGroup and aims it; on deactivation removes it. Cancels any pending pulse.

en.desc: true to enable (any other value disables)

runCapture.desc: Triggers a screenshot taking the flash into account: direct if the flash is inactive or in always mode, with a light pulse in pulse mode.

....desc: Arguments passed to the corresponding screenshot module function (up to 6 depending on the type)

returns.desc: true if the capture is started or scheduled

applyFromUi.desc: Applies the settings coming from the photo mode UI: clamps the values then enables the flash (or disables it if enabled is not true).

fireOnCapture.desc: true for pulse mode, otherwise always

onPreRender.desc: Hook called every frame before rendering: repositions the spotlight on the camera and advances the pulse state machine (warm-up, capture, cleanup, fallback delay).

onScreenshotAllDone.desc: Hook called when all in-progress screenshots are done: starts the cleanup (turning the flash off) of a pending pulse. Ignored if photo mode is not open.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook called on unload: disables the flash and removes the spotlight.
